Aditya / team — here is the technical plan for hosted purge. Attaching a short deletion_plan.md with the checklist.

Summary:
- Scope: All prompt inputs, model-generated outputs, request-level logs and intermediate KV caches containing BF-PII-2023 identifiers on the hosted tenant for BlueFin.
- Exclusions: Dedicated / on-prem infra snapshots and any external SIEM copies (we will flag these but cannot delete them).
- Steps: identify records by dataset tag and request_id prefixes (list provided in attachment), terminate active cache entries, run controlled deletion job that marks rows as deleted, sweep and compact indexes, re-encrypt manifest.
- Backups & evidence: we will take an ephemeral snapshot before deletion for internal audit (retained 30 days), and produce a deletion run log (redwood_deletion_run_20261003.log) plus a short CSV of affected request_ids.
- Expected downtime / impact: no runtime downtime; KV cache misses may increase for ~15 minutes.

Please review the plan in deletion_plan.md and sign off. Once approved, Ops will execute during the Oct 3 window.

Monica Patel
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai
